_comment: CONCEPT:EG-423 — committed perf/recall regression thresholds for the eg-plan hybrid_queries bench, consumed by scripts/bench_gate.py. The recall floor is the TIGHT, deterministic gate (fixed dataset + fixed HNSW params). The per-bench p50 ceilings (nanoseconds) are DELIBERATELY generous (~10-100x a warm local run) so ordinary CI-machine variance never trips them — they only catch a CATASTROPHIC algorithmic regression (e.g. an accidental O(n^2) blowup in a leg). A bench absent under the run's feature set is skipped, not failed.
